\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 232-235 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R240-first-pass-words-from-chapters-232-235}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a seat and a wheel.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item jealous, proud, uneasy, smooth, rough
  \item dark, pale, distant, punctual, patient
  \item important, entertaining, filthy, full, slow
  \item lovely, terrible, amazing, boring, whole
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Jealous? (\textbf{\mr{मत्सरी}}, \emph{matsarī}.) Proud? (\textbf{\mr{अभिमानी}}, \emph{abhimānī}.) Uneasy? (\textbf{\mr{अस्वस्थ}}, \emph{asvastha}.) Smooth? (\textbf{\mr{गुळगुळीत}}, \emph{guḷguḷīt}.) Rough? (\textbf{\mr{खरखरीत}}, \emph{kharkharīt}.) Dark? (\textbf{\mr{गडद}}, \emph{gaḍad}.) Pale? (\textbf{\mr{फिकट}}, \emph{phikaṭ}.) Distant? (\textbf{\mr{दूरचा}}, \emph{dūrcā}.) Punctual? (\textbf{\mr{वक्तशीर}}, \emph{vaktaśīr}.) Patient? (\textbf{\mr{सहनशील}}, \emph{sahanśīl}.) Important? (\textbf{\mr{महत्त्वाचा}}, \emph{mahattvācā}.) Entertaining? (\textbf{\mr{मनोरंजक}}, \emph{manorañjak}.) Filthy? (\textbf{\mr{घाणेरडा}}, \emph{ghāṇerḍā}.) Full? (\textbf{\mr{भरलेला}}, \emph{bharlelā}.) Slow? (\textbf{\mr{मंद}}, \emph{mand}.) Lovely? (\textbf{\mr{सुरेख}}, \emph{surekh}.) Terrible? (\textbf{\mr{भयंकर}}, \emph{bhayaṅkar}.) Amazing? (\textbf{\mr{आश्चर्यकारक}}, \emph{āścaryakārak}.) Boring? (\textbf{\mr{कंटाळवाणा}}, \emph{kaṇṭāḷvāṇā}.) Whole? (\textbf{\mr{संपूर्ण}}, \emph{sampūrṇa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 236-240 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R240-second-pass-words-from-chapters-236-240}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a platform and a passport.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a platform, a passport, octroi, a booking, a river valley
  \item a tradition, a dialect, publicity, a website, a keyboard
  \item a pilot, a researcher, a foreigner, a tourist, an adult
  \item a result, a difference, an example, the truth, a rule
  \item entry, an entrance, luggage, a seat, a wheel
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A platform? (\textbf{\mr{फलाट}}, \emph{phalāṭ}.) A passport? (\textbf{\mr{पारपत्र}}, \emph{pārpatra}.) Octroi? (\textbf{\mr{जकात}}, \emph{jakāt}.) A booking? (\textbf{\mr{आरक्षण}}, \emph{ārakṣaṇ}.) A river valley? (\textbf{\mr{खोरे}}, \emph{khore}.) A tradition? (\textbf{\mr{परंपरा}}, \emph{paramparā}.) A dialect? (\textbf{\mr{बोली}}, \emph{bolī}.) Publicity? (\textbf{\mr{प्रसिद्धी}}, \emph{prasiddhī}.) A website? (\textbf{\mr{संकेतस्थळ}}, \emph{saṅketsthaḷ}.) A keyboard? (\textbf{\mr{कळफलक}}, \emph{kaḷphalak}.) A pilot? (\textbf{\mr{वैमानिक}}, \emph{vaimānik}.) A researcher? (\textbf{\mr{संशोधक}}, \emph{saṁśodhak}.) A foreigner? (\textbf{\mr{परदेशी}}, \emph{pardeśī}.) A tourist? (\textbf{\mr{पर्यटक}}, \emph{paryaṭak}.) An adult? (\textbf{\mr{प्रौढ}}, \emph{prauḍh}.) A result? (\textbf{\mr{निकाल}}, \emph{nikāl}.) A difference? (\textbf{\mr{फरक}}, \emph{pharak}.) An example? (\textbf{\mr{उदाहरण}}, \emph{udāharaṇ}.) The truth? (\textbf{\mr{सत्य}}, \emph{satya}.) A rule? (\textbf{\mr{नियम}}, \emph{niyam}.) Entry? (\textbf{\mr{प्रवेश}}, \emph{praveś}.) An entrance? (\textbf{\mr{प्रवेशद्वार}}, \emph{praveśdvār}.) Luggage? (\textbf{\mr{सामान}}, \emph{sāmān}.) A seat? (\textbf{\mr{आसन}}, \emph{āsan}.) A wheel? (\textbf{\mr{चाक}}, \emph{cāk}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
